items.title: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability (Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output)
items.summary: A critical RCE vulnerability in Adobe Commerce, Magento Open Source, and Adobe Commerce B2B allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network due to improper encoding. This flaw can lead to full storefront compromise, payment data theft, and lateral movement.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-73
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Security Feature Bypass in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and related products allows security controls to be bypassed, resulting in unauthorized read and write access to application resources. Exploitation does not require user interaction.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes (CVSS 9.3) allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in. This vulnerability opens the door to remote code execution, and attacks were observed in the wild on the day the patch shipped.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento (PHP object injection)
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in Mirasvit Cache Warmer (CVSS 9.8) allows remote code execution via a single crafted cookie on any storefront page. All versions of the extension before 1.11.12 are vulnerable.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (APSB26-05)
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could allow attackers to bypass security mechanisms, gain escalated privileges, execute unauthorized malicious code, or compromise customer accounts.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API, named PolyShell, allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store by disguising code as an image. While a fix is in Magento 2.4.9, older supported versions remain vulnerable without backports.

items.title: Critical Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Flaw Allows Customer Account Takeover and RCE (SessionReaper)
items.summary: This critical improper input validation flaw (CVSS 9.1) allows remote unauthenticated attackers to take over customer accounts through the Commerce REST API and potentially achieve Remote Code Execution. Mass attacks exploiting this vulnerability were observed in October 2025, with many stores remaining unpatched.
